Allah help us! Question: Assalamu Alikkum some people are selebrate Nadi [sal] Birth like meelad and there are sing moulood.i wana know meelad and mowlood right or wrong so ple clear my problem. Allah help us! Answer ID: 8737 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1319/1576=L/1429) Celebrating birth anniversary and singing moulood is unlawful as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
